snippet.title: Hakoniwa Electric - 2nd Game Trailer [English]
snippet.description:
Hakoniwa Electric - 2nd Game Trailer

▼Steam Store 🎮️
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4422260/_Hakoniwa_Electric/

ー⚡️⚡️ー
■ What is "Hakoniwa Electric"?
This is a relaxing puzzle exploration game where you find puzzles in nostalgic and cute miniature garden stages and light them up.

"Akari," a novice shop owner, has been entrusted with an electronics store by her grandfather, who is enjoying a vacation in a tropical country. Players accompany Akari to solve small problems brought by the townspeople. It's a game where you can spend a leisurely time observing the changing seasons and the gradually bustling interior of the store.

ー⚡️⚡️ー

​■ Game Specifications
​Title: Hakoniwa Electric
​Genre: Cozy Puzzle-Explorer
​Platform: Steam (PC)
​Supported Languages: Japanese, English
​Release Window: Coming in 2026 
​Steam Store Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4422260/_Hakoniwa_Electric/
​Developer: 亜寝帯 - ANETTAI
